title: all-research-skills: research tooling skills
description:
A collection of research tooling skills. The first, scientific-figures, compiles a declarative specification into journal-ready vector figures for scientific manuscripts: mechanisms of action, pathways, clinical algorithms, study designs and graphical abstracts.

Relations carry a mandatory evidence level rendered through a dedicated visual channel, so a proposed mechanism cannot be drawn as a demonstrated one. Pictorial assets resolve against a registry of open-licensed libraries under a licence gate enforced before rendering. Type size is treated as a hard constraint at the target column width. Output is deterministic vector drawing, with no generative image model at any stage.
